comparison.reason: Native Ant pilots plateau near the alive bonus; computed contacts improved both algorithms at500k. Test full budgets before further tuning, while preserving the native comparison.
limits: Computed contacts change observation values and the native contact penalty; they are a separate adaptation, not proven historical parity.
Initial action scale-1.0 was chosen after development pilots. One reused training seed, not final evidence.
Training source exactly matches the completed contact-mode pilots; this is not a test of later PPO or memory changes.
